purpose: User-selected best-observed Codex development accuracy; distinct from the stakeholder historical baseline; offline reporting only
selection_basis: Explicit user selection after viewing repeated development-run results; not an unbiased aggregate or held-out evaluation
reporting_policy: Use for best observed Codex accuracy questions, not stakeholder baseline accuracy. Verify archived artifact hashes before reporting. Do not make fresh model calls for an accuracy question. Explicit new-run or other-configuration requests remain separate measurements. Best refers to the user-selected saved Codex run, not superiority on every metric over all models.
